note: Curated evergreen and recurring programs. Dates change every cycle, so always confirm details on the official page. Live, dated hackathons are merged in from data/feed.json, which a GitHub Action refreshes daily.

items.title: HGTV Dream Home Giveaway
items.summary: One of the best-known daily-entry home sweepstakes; entries are typically allowed on two partner sites each day.

items.title: HGTV Smart Home Giveaway
items.summary: Spring-season home sweepstakes from the same network; daily entries during the open window.

items.title: Publishers Clearing House Sweepstakes
items.summary: Long-running US sweepstakes brand. No purchase is ever necessary to enter or win — be wary of anyone claiming otherwise.

items.title: XPRIZE Competitions
items.summary: Large incentive prizes for breakthroughs in climate, health, learning and exploration.

items.title: HeroX Open Challenges
items.summary: Crowdsourced challenges posted by agencies and companies, including NASA Tournament Lab problems.

items.title: Kaggle Competitions
items.summary: Machine-learning and data-science competitions with public leaderboards.

items.title: Devpost Hackathons
items.summary: The largest public hackathon directory. Our live feed below pulls open Devpost hackathons daily.

items.title: Major League Hacking Season Events
items.summary: Student hackathon league with in-person and digital weekend events.

items.title: Topcoder Challenges
items.summary: Paid design, development, data and QA challenges for freelance technologists.

items.title: HackerEarth Challenges
items.summary: Competitive programming, hiring challenges and hackathons run by companies.

items.title: Global Game Jam
items.summary: The world's largest game-creation event — build a game in one weekend around a shared theme.

items.title: Ludum Dare Game Jam
items.summary: Classic online game jam with a solo 48-hour compo and a 72-hour team jam.

items.title: Hult Prize
items.summary: Social-enterprise competition for university students, starting with on-campus rounds.

items.title: MIT Solve Global Challenges
items.summary: Open innovation challenges for tech-based social impact solutions.

items.title: James Dyson Award
items.summary: International design award for students and recent graduates who solve a real problem.

items.title: Breakthrough Junior Challenge
items.summary: Make a short video explaining a big idea in science or math.

items.title: Regeneron Science Talent Search
items.summary: The oldest US science competition for high-school seniors.

items.title: Scholastic Art & Writing Awards
items.summary: Long-running recognition program for teen artists and writers.

items.title: Commonwealth Short Story Prize

items.title: Sony World Photography Awards
items.summary: Global photo awards with free-to-enter open and student categories.

items.title: CBC Literary Prizes
items.summary: Canada's long-running prizes for short story, nonfiction and poetry.

items.title: Coca-Cola Scholars Program
items.summary: Achievement-based scholarship for leadership and service.

items.title: The Gates Scholarship

items.title: Dell Scholars Program

items.title: Loran Award

items.title: Schulich Leader Scholarships

items.title: Fastweb Scholarship Search
